To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we present a formulation for dummy fill insertion to balance the competing requirements of reducing POF and improving planarity and we show that the LP formulation based solution results in substantially reduced critical areas.

the proposed layout density analysis model and LP formulation based dummy metal fill insertion technique result in substantially reduced POF and also improves surface planarity while satisfying the layout uniformity criteria.

a) the proposed LP formulation based fill and SRAF insertion techniques result in a substantial reduction in critical area, b) the LP formulation is more scalable than the greedy and variable spacing fill insertion techniques, and c) the proposed LP based solution can be implemented in an ASIC flow.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a layout design solution that improves manufacturing yield and reduces the impact on timing and crosstalking.
developing a methodology to improve the manufacturability of ICs through dummy fill insertion.
the development of a novel methodology to address the challenges of manufacturing yield in advanced CMOS technology.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed LP formulation based fill solution is the most effective solution to reduce critical area and hence improve yield.
the variable spacing based fill insertion technique provides a good balance between the competing objectives of yield improvement and layout density.
the LP formulation based solution is the most effective in terms of reducing POF while satisfying the layout design constraints.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the LP formulation based dummy fill insertion technique is the most effective in reducing critical area, while maintaining the layout density criteria.
the variable spacing based fill insertion technique provides a good trade-off between the conflicting goals of minimizing critical area and maintaining layout density and uniform spacing constraints.
the LP formulation based technique provides the most scalable solution for fill insertions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed LP based dummy fill insertion technique provides a scalable solution that balances yield and timing goals and can be used as a part of the overall layout optimization flow.
critical area based dummy fill insertion is a viable solution to improve yield while also improving lithography performance.
a layout design solution that minimizes yield loss due to particulate related defects and improves planarity is possible.
